title: MxAgile Capability Registry
description: Machine-readable catalog of developer-visible MxAgile capabilities.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this registry format.

assessed.description: ISO date when external dependencies were last assessed.

description.description: One-line description of the capability's purpose.

version_introduced.description: MxAgile framework version that introduced this capability.

default_state.description: Whether capability is on or off when config is absent.

config_location.description: Path to the configuration file, relative to project root.

config_key.description: Dot-path to the controlling configuration key.

activation_mechanism.description: Human-readable instructions for enabling this capability.

requires.description: Capability IDs that must be enabled before this one.

external_dependencies.description: External tools or packages required by this capability.

incompatibilities.description: Capability IDs that cannot be active at the same time.

availability_detection.description: How to detect whether this capability is available in the current environment.

risk.description: Risk level if this capability is mis-configured.

docs_ref.description: Documentation file path, relative to project root.

agent_may_recommend.description: Whether an AI agent may proactively surface this capability.

agent_may_activate_config.description: Whether an AI agent may safely edit project config to enable this capability.

user_approval_required.description: Whether enabling requires external software installation or global machine mutation.

notes.description: Optional additional notes for agents and operators.

executable.description: Executable name to detect in PATH.

version_constraint.description: Semver constraint string for a compatible version.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or short description.

assessed_version.description: Version or revision assessed when this entry was written.

assessed_date.description: ISO date of the upstream assessment.

license_note.description: Additional licensing notes relevant to integration decisions.
